## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Impact

Explain user, format, compatibility, privacy, or provenance effects.

## Validation

List the checks, tests, or recordings used. Do not attach private data.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests or validation were added where appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, private recordings, or restricted data are included.
- [ ] Captured, reconstructed, inferred, and generated content is labeled accurately.
